column1: # How every corpus is acquired. model/jobs/corpus.sbatch <key> reads one row.
#             sra-bam      Cell Ranger BAM from EBI's SRA mirror, via bamtofastq
#             ebi-files    per-lane fastq.gz under an EBI BioStudies accession
#             permuted-from  scrm-permute rewrites a built corpus
# source      k=v;k=v locator for the kind
# whitelist   h5 | tar:<member> | repo:<path> | geo:<GSM>#<file> | json:<path>#<sample>
# species     for gene-set and ortholog selection
# tools       external programs beyond the conda env, ; separated
